## Libraries

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
```

# Make data (correlated)

```{r}
a=rnorm(20,2,1)
b=a+rnorm(20,1.5,.3)

A <- data.frame(placebo=a, treatment=b)
AA <- pivot_longer(data=A, cols=c(placebo, treatment), names_to="drug", values_to="effect") |> 
        mutate(drug=factor(drug, levels=c("placebo", "treatment"))) |> 
        mutate(group=case_when(drug == "placebo" ~ 0, .default=1)) 
```

```{r}
A

AA
```

```{r}
# ggplot(A, aes(a,b)) + 
#   geom_point()

ggplot(AA, aes(drug, effect)) + 
  geom_point()

ggplot(AA, aes(group, effect)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method="lm") + 
  #stat_regline_equation() + 
  stat_cor() 
```

```{r}
t.test(A$placebo, A$treatment) |> tidy()
```

```{r}
AA %>% t_test(effect ~ drug)
```

```{r}
AA %>% lm(effect ~ drug, data=.) %>% summary() |> tidy()
```
